verdict.rationale: Google's own support docs state that by default chats/uploaded files aren't used to improve generative AI models unless a user opts in via 'Keep Activity', and that users can review, delete activity, or turn off Keep Activity at any time; separately, users must explicitly consent to let Google use Gemini Live audio/video for model training. This gives knowledge-workers clear, documented control over whether conversations feed model training. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these settings work as described and clarity on enterprise/Workspace account defaults.
